title: Hijri calendar
description: Umm al-Qura calendar with the mosque's correction

note.base: Dates follow the Umm al-Qura calendar used in Saudi Arabia. The actual start of a month depends on the moon sighting announcement; follow the mosque's announcement for Ramadan and Eid.
note.adjusted: The mosque committee has applied a correction of {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} to the calendar.
note.notAdjusted: No correction is currently applied by the mosque committee.
